name: Paresh Chauhan
bio: Passionate Android developer with hands-on experience building robust, user-friendly mobile applications using Kotlin and Java. Skilled in XML-based UI design, Firebase integration, REST APIs, and crafting smooth mobile experiences.

education.description: Studied computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, software engineering, and mobile application development.

experience.description: Developed and delivered multiple Android applications for clients using Kotlin and Java. Implemented MVVM architecture, Firebase integration, and REST API consumption. Managed projects independently from requirements gathering to Play Store deployment.

Built and maintained Android applications for enterprise clients. Worked on XML UI design, API integration with Retrofit, and local data storage with Room DB. Collaborated with cross-functional teams using Git workflows.
